name: Wash or matched trades between connected parties
description: Assets or securities are traded repeatedly between linked accounts or wallets at unrealistic prices.
fp: Collectors moving assets between own wallets.

links.name: Wash trading between wallets controlled by the same party
links.ctx: NFTs are sold repeatedly between linked wallets at rising prices without genuine third-party demand.
links.fp: Collectors moving assets between own wallets.

links.name: Wash or matched trades between connected accounts
links.ctx: Same securities traded between related accounts at unrealistic prices.

links.name: Wash or matched trades between connected parties
links.ctx: Repeated buying and selling of the same instrument or token between connected accounts at no real change of beneficial ownership, creating false volume or a price trail that justifies deposits and withdrawals.
